Set-Location -Path 'J:\inkubator'; $code = @'
const fs = require("fs");
const srcPath = "firmware/data/index.html";
const tgtPath = "firmware/data/indexv1.html";
let src = fs.readFileSync(srcPath, 'utf8').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
const importBlock = '<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/uplot@1.9.20/dist/uPlot.iife.min.js"></script>';
const importIdx = src.indexOf(importBlock);
if (importIdx < 0) throw new Error('uPlot import not found');
const kalStart = src.indexOf('<script id="kal-script">');
if (kalStart < 0) throw new Error('kal-script start not found');
const kalEnd = src.indexOf('</script>', kalStart);
if (kalEnd < 0) throw new Error('kal-script end not found');
const kalBlock = src.slice(kalStart, kalEnd + 9);
const mainMarker = '<script>\nconst DAY_MS=86400000;';
const mainStart = src.indexOf(mainMarker);
if (mainStart < 0) throw new Error('main script start not found');
const mainEnd = src.indexOf('</script>', mainStart);
if (mainEnd < 0) throw new Error('main script end not found');
const mainBody = src.slice(mainStart + '<script>\n'.length, mainEnd);
let tgt = fs.readFileSync(tgtPath, 'utf8').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
const scriptOpen = '<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════\n       SKRYPTY – cały JS z dużego pliku\n  ════════════════════════════════════════════\n  <script>\n';
const insertPoint = tgt.indexOf(scriptOpen);
if (insertPoint < 0) throw new Error('script open marker not found');
const before = tgt.slice(0, insertPoint);
const after = tgt.slice(insertPoint + scriptOpen.length);
const newIntro = scriptOpen + importBlock + '\n\n' + kalBlock + '\n\n' + '<script>\n';
tgt = before + newIntro + after;
const placeholder = '    // ─── POZOSTAŁE FUNKCJE Z ORYGINAŁU ──────\n    // (w tym miejscu wklej cały brakujący JS z index (7).html)\n    // Ze względu na długość, w tej odpowiedzi pomijam szczegóły,\n    // ale wszystkie funkcje są dostępne w oryginalnym pliku.\n\n    console.log(\'Panel INC-2 – wersja industrialna (kompletna)\');';
if (tgt.indexOf(placeholder) < 0) throw new Error('placeholder not found in target');
tgt = tgt.replace(placeholder, mainBody + '\n    console.log(\'Panel INC-2 – wersja industrialna (kompletna)\');');
fs.writeFileSync(tgtPath + '.bak', fs.readFileSync(tgtPath, 'utf8'));
fs.writeFileSync(tgtPath, tgt.replace(/\n/g, '\r\n'), 'utf8');
console.log('patched successfully');
'@
Set-Content -Path 'patch_indexv1.js' -Value $code -NoNewline
node patch_indexv1.js
```

fs.writeFileSync(v1, patched, 'utf8');

const fs = require('fs');
const src = 'firmware/data/index.html';
const target = 'firmware/data/indexv1.html';
const srcText = fs.readFileSync(src, 'utf8');
const startMarker = '<!-- ===== KALIBRACJA TACY – z poprawkami ===== -->';
const startIndex = srcText.indexOf(startMarker);
if (startIndex < 0) {
  console.error('start marker not found in source');
  process.exit(1);
}
const fullStart = srcText.lastIndexOf('<!-- ============================================================ -->', startIndex);
if (fullStart < 0) {
  console.error('full start delimiter not found before start marker');
  process.exit(1);
}
const endMarker = '</div><!-- end view-kalibracja -->';
const endIndex = srcText.indexOf(endMarker, startIndex);
if (endIndex < 0) {
  console.error('end marker not found in source');
  process.exit(1);
}
const block = srcText.slice(fullStart, endIndex + endMarker.length);
const targetText = fs.readFileSync(target, 'utf8');
if (targetText.includes('id="view-kalibracja"')) {
  console.log('target already contains view-kalibracja');
  process.exit(0);
}
const insertMarker = '<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/uplot@1.9.20/dist/uPlot.iife.min.js"></script>';
const insertPos = targetText.indexOf(insertMarker);
if (insertPos < 0) {
  console.error('insert marker not found in target');
  process.exit(1);
}
const patched = targetText.slice(0, insertPos) + block + '\n\n  ' + targetText.slice(insertPos);
fs.writeFileSync(target, patched, 'utf8');
console.log('patched target with view-kalibracja block');

```

```
function showTab(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach((t)=>t.classList.toggle('active',t.dataset.tab===name));
  document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle('active',v.id==='view-'+name));
  if(name==='config-suite'){ switchConfigSuiteTab('config'); }
  if(name==='journal-suite'){ switchJournalSuiteTab('journal'); }
  if(name==='harmonogram'){ loadSchedule(0); loadSchedule(1); }
  if(name==='dziennik'){ journalRefreshUI(); }
  if(name==='logi'){ renderEventLog(); }
  if(name==='status'){ setTimeout(()=>{ if(chartState.lastStatus) updatePipBoy(chartState.lastStatus,deviceState.trays||[]); },50); }
  if(name==='panel'){ setTimeout(renderHistoryPanelsDeb,80); }
  if(name==='kalibracja'){ setTimeout(()=>{ const c=document.getElementById('kal-canvas'); if(c){ drawTray(KAL.angle); } },50); }
}

function switchConfigSuiteTab(subtab){
  document.querySelectorAll('.config-suite-content').forEach(el=>el.style.display='none');
  document.querySelectorAll('.config-suite-tab').forEach(btn=>btn.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('config-suite-'+subtab).style.display='block';
  document.querySelector('.config-suite-tab[data-subtab="'+subtab+'"]').classList.add('active');
  if(subtab==='config'){}
  if(subtab==='kalibracja'){ setTimeout(()=>{ const c=document.getElementById('kal-canvas'); if(c) drawTray(KAL.angle); },50); }
  if(subtab==='logi'){ renderEventLog(); }
}

function switchJournalSuiteTab(subtab){
  document.querySelectorAll('.journal-suite-content').forEach(el=>el.style.display='none');
  document.querySelectorAll('.journal-suite-tab').forEach(btn=>btn.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('journal-suite-'+subtab).style.display='block';
  document.querySelector('.journal-suite-tab[data-subtab="'+subtab+'"]').classList.add('active');
  if(subtab==='journal'){ journalRefreshUI(); }
  if(subtab==='harmonogram'){ loadSchedule(0); loadSchedule(1); }
}

function logEvent(type,msg){
  eventLog.push({ts:Date.now(),type,msg});
  if(eventLog.length>EVENT_LOG_MAX) eventLog.shift();
  const lv=document.getElementById('view-logi');
  if(lv&&lv.classList.contains('active')) renderEventLog();
}
```

function showTab(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach((t)=>t.classList.toggle('active',t.dataset.tab===name));
  document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle('active',v.id==='view-'+name));
  if(name==='harmonogram'){ loadSchedule(0); loadSchedule(1); }
  if(name==='dziennik'){ journalRefreshUI(); }
  if(name==='logi'){ renderEventLog(); }
  if(name==='status'){ setTimeout(()=>{ if(chartState.lastStatus) updatePipBoy(chartState.lastStatus,deviceState.trays||[]); },50); }
  if(name==='panel'){ setTimeout(renderHistoryPanelsDeb,80); }
  if(name==='kalibracja'){ setTimeout(()=>{ const c=document.getElementById('kal-canvas'); if(c){ drawTray(KAL.angle); } },50); }
}
function logEvent(type,msg){
  eventLog.push({ts:Date.now(),type,msg});
  if(eventLog.length>EVENT_LOG_MAX) eventLog.shift();
  const lv=document.getElementById('view-logi');
  if(lv&&lv.classList.contains('active')) renderEventLog();
}

function switchConfigSuiteTab(subtab){
  // Hide all config-related views
  ['config', 'kalibracja', 'logi'].forEach(v => {
    const el = document.getElementById('view-' + v);
    if(el) el.style.display = 'none';
  });
  
  // Show the selected subtab
  const selected = document.getElementById('view-' + subtab);
  if(selected) selected.style.display = 'block';
  
  // Update button states
  document.querySelectorAll('.config-suite-tab').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector('.config-suite-tab[data-subtab="'+subtab+'"]').classList.add('active');
  
  // Trigger view-specific setup
  if(subtab === 'kalibracja'){
    setTimeout(()=>{ 
      const c = document.getElementById('kal-canvas'); 
      if(c) drawTray(KAL.angle); 
    }, 50);
  }
  if(subtab === 'logi'){ 
    renderEventLog();
  }
}

function switchJournalSuiteTab(subtab){
  // Hide all journal-related views
  ['journal', 'harmonogram'].forEach(v => {
    const el = document.getElementById('view-' + v);
    if(el) el.style.display = 'none';
  });
  
  // Show the selected subtab
  const selected = document.getElementById('view-' + subtab);
  if(selected) selected.style.display = 'block';
  
  // Update button states
  document.querySelectorAll('.journal-suite-tab').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector('.journal-suite-tab[data-subtab="'+subtab+'"]').classList.add('active');
  
  // Trigger view-specific setup
  if(subtab === 'journal'){ 
    journalRefreshUI();
  }
  if(subtab === 'harmonogram'){ 
    loadSchedule(0); 
    loadSchedule(1);
  }
}
```

    :root {

    .device-header {

    .toolbar {

    .alarms-block {

      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      min-width: 44px;
      text-align: right;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .pwm-value.active.cyan  { color: var(--cyan); }
    .pwm-value.active.red   { color: var(--red); }
    .pwm-value.forced.amber { color: var(--amber); }

    .pwm-leds {
      display: flex;
      gap: 3px;
      padding-top: 6px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    }
    .pwm-led {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      background: #0a1016;
      border: 1px solid #1a252c;
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .pwm-led.on.cyan {
      background: var(--cyan);
      border-color: var(--cyan-dim);
      box-shadow: var(--cyan-glow);
    }
    .pwm-led.on.red {
      background: var(--red);
      border-color: var(--red-dim);
      box-shadow: var(--red-glow);
    }
    .pwm-led.on.amber {
      background: var(--amber);
      border-color: var(--amber-dim);
      box-shadow: var(--amber-glow);
    }

    /* ─── DZIENNIK ─── */
    .journal-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .journal-entry {
      background: var(--steel-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .journal-entry .time { color: var(--text-dim); }
    .journal-entry .msg  { color: var(--text-mid); }

    /* ─── SYSTEM ─── */
    .sys-info {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px,1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      background: var(--steel-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      padding: 16px;
    }
    .sys-info .item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
    }
    .sys-info .item .key { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; }
    .sys-info .item .val { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); }

    /* ─── RESPONSYWNOŚĆ ─── */
    @media (max-width: 1200px) {
      .toolbar { flex-wrap: wrap; height: auto; gap: 2px; padding: 4px 0; }
      .nav-wrap { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
      .vsep { display: none; }
      .right-group { margin-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); width: 100%; justify-content: flex-end; }
      .sys-block { border-left: none; }
      .clock-block { border-left: none; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 760px) {
      .tray-block { padding: 0 8px; gap: 6px; }
      .prog-track { width: 50px; }
      .alarms-block { padding: 0 6px; }
      .sys-block { gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .clock-block { padding: 0 10px; }
      .clk-time { font-size: 17px; }
      .gauges-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .gauge-cell { min-width: 130px; }
      .config-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 500px) {
      .nav-btn { padding: 0 12px; font-size: 10px; }
      .tray-block .tray-id-col { display: none; }
      .tray-block .stage-tag { display: none; }
      .alarms-block .alarm-row .alarm-text { display: none; }
      .alarm-led { width: 6px; height: 6px; }
      .conn-grid { display: none; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════
       DEVICE HEADER
  ════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="device-header">
    <div class="device-id">INC‑2 &nbsp;// &nbsp;<span>PANEL OPERATORSKI</span></div>
    <div style="letter-spacing:1px">PROTOKÓŁ&nbsp;v2.4.1&nbsp;·&nbsp;ESP32‑S3</div>
  </div>

  <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════
       TOOLBAR
  ════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="toolbar">

    <nav class="nav-wrap">
      <button class="nav-btn active" data-tab="status">STATUS</button>
      <button class="nav-btn"        data-tab="config">KONFIG</button>
      <button class="nav-btn"        data-tab="journal">DZIENNIK</button>
      <button class="nav-btn"        data-tab="system">SYSTEM</button>
    </nav>

    <div class="vsep"></div>

    <!-- TACA 1 -->
    <div class="tray-block">
      <div class="tray-id-col">
        <span class="tray-num">T-1</span>
        <div class="tray-led cyan"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-data">
        <span class="tray-species cyan">KURA</span>
        <div class="tray-meta">
          <span class="stage-tag incub">INKUB.</span>
          <span>12/21 dni</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-progress">
        <div class="prog-track"><div class="prog-fill cyan" style="width:57%"></div></div>
        <div class="prog-labels"><span>0</span><span>↑7d</span><span>21</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="vsep"></div>

    <!-- TACA 2 -->
    <div class="tray-block">
      <div class="tray-id-col">
        <span class="tray-num">T-2</span>
        <div class="tray-led amber" style="animation:blink-slow 1.5s infinite"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-data">
        <span class="tray-species amber">KACZKA</span>
        <div class="tray-meta">
          <span class="stage-tag lock">LOCKDOWN</span>
          <span>26/28 dni</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-progress">
        <div class="prog-track"><div class="prog-fill amber" style="width:100%"></div></div>
        <div class="prog-labels"><span>0</span><span style="color:var(--amber)">↑2d</span><span>28</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="vsep"></div>

    <!-- ALARMY -->
    <div class="alarms-block">
      <div class="alarm-row">
        <div class="alarm-led warn"></div>
        <span class="alarm-text warn">TEMP +1.2°C</span>
      </div>
      <div class="alarm-row">
        <div class="alarm-led danger"></div>
        <span class="alarm-text danger">WILG. −4%</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PRAWA STRONA -->
    <div class="right-group">

      <div class="sys-block">
        <div class="sys-col">
          <span class="sys-label">T-CHIP</span>
          <span class="sys-val hot" id="esp-temp">41.8°C</span>
        </div>
        <div class="sys-col">
          <div class="mini-meter">
            <span class="mini-key">RAM</span>
            <div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill cyan" style="width:62%"></div></div>
            <span class="mini-num" id="esp-ram">62%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="mini-meter">
            <span class="mini-key">FL</span>
            <div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill blue" style="width:18%"></div></div>
            <span class="mini-num" id="esp-fl">18%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="sys-col">
          <span class="sys-label">STATUS</span>
          <div class="conn-grid">
            <div class="conn-item"><div class="conn-led on"></div>WiFi</div>
            <div class="conn-item"><div class="conn-led on"></div>MQTT</div>
            <div class="conn-item"><div class="conn-led mid"></div>NTP</div>
            <div class="conn-item"><div class="conn-led off"></div>BLE</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="clock-block">
        <div class="clk-time" id="clk-hms">--:--:--</div>
        <div class="clk-date" id="clk-date">--.--.----</div>
        <div class="clk-pulse">
          <div class="pulse-dot" id="p0"></div>
          <div class="pulse-dot" id="p1"></div>
          <div class="pulse-dot" id="p2"></div>
          <div class="pulse-dot" id="p3"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════
       WIDOKI
  ════════════════════════════════════════ -->

  <!-- ─── STATUS ─── -->
  <div id="view-status" class="view active">
    <div class="gauges-row">

      <div class="gauge-cell">
        <span class="gauge-label">TEMP. INKUB.</span>
        <svg class="gauge-svg" viewBox="0 0 160 100">
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#1a2228" stroke-width="10"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#003322" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="120 189" stroke-dashoffset="-35"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="94 189" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          <g fill="none" stroke="#2a3840" stroke-width="1">
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-90,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="24" y2="90" transform="rotate(-67.5,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="24" y2="90" transform="rotate(-22.5,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(0,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="24" y2="90" transform="rotate(22.5,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="24" y2="90" transform="rotate(67.5,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(90,80,90)"/>
          </g>
          <text x="16" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">35</text>
          <text x="144" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">42</text>
          <text x="80" y="36" fill="#2a8060" font-size="7" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">▌NORMA▐</text>
          <line x1="80" y1="90" x2="80" y2="36" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(25,80,90)"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="4" fill="var(--steel-2)" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="var(--cyan)"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="gauge-reading" style="color:var(--cyan)">37.8</div>
        <div class="gauge-unit">°C &nbsp;[35–42]</div>
      </div>

      <div class="gauge-cell">
        <span class="gauge-label">WILGOTNOŚĆ</span>
        <svg class="gauge-svg" viewBox="0 0 160 100">
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#1a2228" stroke-width="10"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#002233" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="94 189" stroke-dashoffset="-47"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="75 189" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          <g fill="none" stroke="#2a3840" stroke-width="1">
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-90,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(0,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(90,80,90)"/>
          </g>
          <text x="16" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">30</text>
          <text x="144" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">80</text>
          <line x1="80" y1="90" x2="80" y2="36" stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-width="1.5" transform="rotate(-10,80,90)"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="4" fill="var(--steel-2)" stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="var(--amber)"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="gauge-reading" style="color:var(--amber)">48</div>
        <div class="gauge-unit">%RH &nbsp;[45–75]</div>
      </div>

      <div class="gauge-cell">
        <span class="gauge-label">TEMP. ZEWN.</span>
        <svg class="gauge-svg" viewBox="0 0 160 100">
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#1a2228" stroke-width="10"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#4488cc" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="82 189" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          <g fill="none" stroke="#2a3840" stroke-width="1">
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-90,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(0,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(90,80,90)"/>
          </g>
          <text x="16" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">-5</text>
          <text x="144" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">40</text>
          <line x1="80" y1="90" x2="80" y2="36" stroke="#4488cc" stroke-width="1.5" transform="rotate(8,80,90)"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="4" fill="var(--steel-2)" stroke="#4488cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="#4488cc"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="gauge-reading" style="color:#4488cc">14.2</div>
        <div class="gauge-unit">°C &nbsp;[−5..+40]</div>
      </div>

      <div class="gauge-cell">
        <span class="gauge-label">CIŚNIENIE</span>
        <svg class="gauge-svg" viewBox="0 0 160 100">
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#1a2228" stroke-width="10"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#002a20" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="95 189" stroke-dashoffset="-47"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="95 189" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          <g fill="none" stroke="#2a3840" stroke-width="1">
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-90,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(0,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(90,80,90)"/>
          </g>
          <text x="14" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">980</text>
          <text x="146" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">1050</text>
          <line x1="80" y1="90" x2="80" y2="36" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="1.5" transform="rotate(3,80,90)"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="4" fill="var(--steel-2)" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="var(--cyan)"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="gauge-reading" style="color:var(--cyan)">1013</div>
        <div class="gauge-unit">hPa &nbsp;[980–1050]</div>
      </div>

    </div>
    <!-- miejsce na dodatkowe karty statusu (np. tace, wykresy) -->
    <div style="background:var(--steel-2);border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:16px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--font-ui);letter-spacing:1px">
      Szczegółowe dane tac, wykresy, ostrzeżenia – rozbudowa w kolejnych krokach
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ─── KONFIG ─── -->
  <div id="view-config" class="view">
    <div class="config-grid">

      <!-- Grzałka CH0 -->
      <div class="config-card">
        <div class="card-title">Grzałka CH0</div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:8px">
          <span style="font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim)">Tryb</span>
          <div class="sw" data-ch="grz0">
            <button class="sw-btn is-off" data-val="off" title="OFF"><span class="sym">⏹</span></button>
            <button class="sw-btn is-selected" data-val="auto" title="AUTO"><span class="sym">⚙</span></button>
            <button class="sw-btn" data-val="on" title="ON"><span class="sym">▶</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pwm-module" data-type="heater" data-ch="grz0-pwm">
          <div class="pwm-head">
            <span class="pwm-label">Moc PWM</span>
            <span style="font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:9px;color:var(--text-dim)" id="grz0-status">AUTO · pracuje</span>
          </div>
          <div class="pwm-slider-row">
            <div class="pwm-slider-track" data-pwm="grz0">
              <div class="pwm-slider-fill red" style="width:0%"></div>
              <div class="pwm-thumb" style="left:0%"></div>
            </div>
            <span class="pwm-value active red" data-pwm-val="grz0">0</span>
          </div>
          <div class="pwm-leds" data-pwm-leds="grz0">
            <div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div>
            <div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Grzałka CH1 -->
      <div class="config-card">
        <div class="card-title">Grzałka CH1</div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:8px">
          <span style="font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim)">Tryb</span>
          <div class="sw" data-ch="grz1">
            <button class="sw-btn is-off" data-val="off" title="OFF"><span class="sym">⏹</span></button>
            <button class="sw-btn is-selected" data-val="auto" title="AUTO"><span class="sym">⚙</span></button>
            <button class="sw-btn" data-val="on" title="ON"><span class="sym">▶</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pwm-module" data-type="heater" data-ch="grz1-pwm">
          <div class="pwm-head">
            <span class="pwm-label">Moc PWM</span>
            <span style="font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:9px;color:var(--text-dim)" id="grz1-status">AUTO · bezczynna</span>
          </div>
          <div class="pwm-slider-row">
            <div class="pwm-slider-track" data-pwm="grz1">
              <div class="pwm-slider-fill red" style="width:0%"></div>
              <div class="pwm-thumb" style="left:0%"></div>
            </div>
            <span class="pwm-value active red" data-pwm-val="grz1">0</span>
          </div>
          <div class="pwm-leds" data-pwm-leds="grz1">
            <div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div>
            <div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Taca T-1 -->
      <div class="config-card">
        <div class="card-title">Taca T-1</div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:8px">
          <span style="font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim)">Tryb</span>
          <div class="sw" data-ch="tray1">
            <button class="sw-btn is-off" data-val="off" title="OFF"><span class="sym">⏹</span></button>
            <button class="sw-btn is-selected" data-val="auto" title="AUTO"><span class="sym">⚙</span></button>
            <button class="sw-btn" data-val="on" title="ON"><span class="sym">▶</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pwm-module" data-type="tray" data-ch="tray1-pwm">
          <div class="pwm-head">
            <span class="pwm-label">Prędkość obrotu</span>
            <span style="font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:9px;color:var(--cyan)" id="tray1-status">AUTO · obrót aktywny</span>
          </div>
          <div class="pwm-slider-row">
            <div class="pwm-slider-track" data-pwm="tray1">
              <div class="pwm-slider-fill cyan" style="width:0%"></div>
              <div class="pwm-thumb" style="left:0%"></div>
            </div>
            <span class="pwm-value active cyan" data-pwm-val="tray1">0</span>
          </div>
          <div class="pwm-leds" data-pwm-leds="tray1">
            <div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div>
            <div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div><div class="pwm-led"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Taca T-2 (z alarmem) -->
      <div class="config-card">
        <div class="card-title">Taca T-2</div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:8px">
          <span style="font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim)">Tryb</span>
          <div class="sw" data-ch="tray2">
            <button class="sw-btn is-off" data-val="off" title="OFF"><span class="sym">⏹</span></button>
            <button class="sw-btn is-selected has-alarm" data-val="auto" title="AUTO"><span class="sym">⚙</span></button>
            <button class="sw-btn" data-val="on" title="ON"><span class="sym">▶</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pwm-module" data-type="tray" data-ch="tray2-pwm">
          <div class="pwm-head">

      Pełny dziennik inkubacji z możliwością dodawania wpisów – rozbudowa w kolejnych krokach
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ─── SYSTEM ─── -->
  <div id="view-system" class="view">
    <div class="sys-info">
      <div class="item"><span class="key">Firmware</span><span class="val">v2.4.1-dev</span></div>

    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:12px;background:var(--steel-2);border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:16px;font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);text-align:center">

    </div>

  <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════
       SKRYPTY
  ════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <script>
    (function() {
      'use strict';

      // ─── ZEGAR ──────────────────────────────
      function updateClock() {
        const now = new Date();
        document.getElementById('clk-hms').textContent =
          now.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL', { hour12: false });
        document.getElementById('clk-date').textContent =
          now.toLocaleDateString('pl-PL', { day:'2-digit', month:'2-digit', year:'numeric' });

        const s = now.getSeconds() % 4;
        for (let i=0; i<4; i++) {
          const d = document.getElementById('p'+i);
          if (d) d.classList.toggle('active', i === s);
        }
      }
      updateClock();
      setInterval(updateClock, 1000);

      // ─── NAWIGACJA ──────────────────────────
      const navBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn');
      const views = {
        status: document.getElementById('view-status'),
        config: document.getElementById('view-config'),
        journal: document.getElementById('view-journal'),
        system: document.getElementById('view-system')
      };

      navBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          navBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
          this.classList.add('active');

          const tab = this.dataset.tab;
          Object.keys(views).forEach(key => {
            views[key].classList.toggle('active', key === tab);
          });
        });
      });

      // ─── PRZEŁĄCZNIKI (SW) ──────────────────
      document.querySelectorAll('.sw').forEach(sw => {
        const btns = sw.querySelectorAll('.sw-btn');
        btns.forEach(btn => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const val = this.dataset.val;
            // Zdejmij zaznaczenie z wszystkich w tym sw
            btns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('is-selected', 'is-off', 'is-active', 'is-forced', 'has-alarm'));
            // Zaznacz kliknięty
            this.classList.add('is-selected');
            if (val === 'off') this.classList.add('is-off');

            // Emituj zdarzenie
            const ch = sw.dataset.ch;
            sw.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sw-change', {
              bubbles: true,
              detail: { ch, val }
            }));
          });
        });
      });

      // ─── PWM ─────────────────────────────────
      // Inicjalizacja każdego modułu PWM
      document.querySelectorAll('.pwm-module').forEach(module => {
        const track = module.querySelector('.pwm-slider-track');
        const fill = track.querySelector('.pwm-slider-fill');
        const thumb = track.querySelector('.pwm-thumb');
        const valSpan = module.querySelector('[data-pwm-val]');
        const leds = module.querySelectorAll('[data-pwm-leds] .pwm-led');
        const type = module.dataset.type || 'heater'; // 'heater' lub 'tray'
        const ch = module.dataset.ch;

        let value = 0;
        let active = false;
        let forced = false;

        function render() {
          const pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (value / 255) * 100));
          thumb.style.left = pct + '%';
          fill.style.width = pct + '%';
          valSpan.textContent = value;

          const on = active;
          const forcedClass = forced ? 'amber' : (type === 'heater' ? 'red' : 'cyan');
          const offClass = type === 'heater' ? 'red' : 'cyan';

          fill.className = 'pwm-slider-fill ' + (on ? (forced ? 'amber' : offClass) : '') + (on ? ' active' : '');
          valSpan.className = 'pwm-value' + (on ? ' active ' + (forced ? 'amber' : offClass) : '');

          const ledCount = Math.round((value / 255) * leds.length);
          leds.forEach((led, i) => {
            led.className = 'pwm-led';
            if (on && i < ledCount) {
              led.classList.add('on', forced ? 'amber' : offClass);
            }
          });
        }

        // Obsługa suwaka
        let dragging = false;

        function handleMove(e) {
          const rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
          let x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
          x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
          value = Math.round(x * 255);
          render();
          // wyślij zdarzenie
          track.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pwm-change', {
            bubbles: true,
            detail: { ch, value }
          }));
        }

        track.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
          dragging = true;
          handleMove(e);
          document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
          document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
        });

        function onMouseMove(e) { if (dragging) handleMove(e); }
        function onMouseUp() {
          dragging = false;
          document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
          document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
        }

        track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { handleMove(e.touches[0]); e.preventDefault(); });
        track.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { handleMove(e.touches[0]); e.preventDefault(); });

        // API dla modułu
        module.pwmApi = {
          setValue: (v) => { value = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, Math.round(v))); render(); },
          setActive: (a) => { active = a; render(); },
          setForced: (f) => { forced = f; render(); },
          getValue: () => value,
          getState: () => ({ value, active, forced })
        };

        render();
      });

      // ─── SYMULACJA DANYCH (przykład) ────────
      // Ustawiamy przykładowe wartości dla PWM
      setTimeout(() => {
        const grz0 = document.querySelector('[data-ch="grz0-pwm"]')?.pwmApi;
        const grz1 = document.querySelector('[data-ch="grz1-pwm"]')?.pwmApi;
        const tray1 = document.querySelector('[data-ch="tray1-pwm"]')?.pwmApi;
        const tray2 = document.querySelector('[data-ch="tray2-pwm"]')?.pwmApi;

        if (grz0) { grz0.setValue(180); grz0.setActive(true); }
        if (grz1) { grz1.setValue(80); grz1.setActive(false); }
        if (tray1) { tray1.setValue(140); tray1.setActive(true); }
        if (tray2) { tray2.setValue(0); tray2.setActive(false); }

        // Zmiana statusów w etykietach
        document.getElementById('grz0-status').textContent = 'AUTO · pracuje';
        document.getElementById('grz1-status').textContent = 'AUTO · bezczynna';
        document.getElementById('tray1-status').textContent = 'AUTO · obrót aktywny';
        document.getElementById('tray2-status').textContent = 'ALARM · lockdown';
      }, 200);

    })();
  </script>

</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>INC-2 // Panel Operatorski</title>
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Share+Tech+Mono&family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@300;400;600&display=swap');

    /* ─── GŁÓWNE ZMIENNE ─── */
    :root {
      --steel-bg:    #0a0c0e;
      --steel-1:     #111416;
      --steel-2:     #171b1e;
      --steel-3:     #1e2428;
      --panel-edge:  #252d32;
      --rule:        #2a3238;
      --rule-hi:     #364048;

      --cyan:        #00d4cc;
      --cyan-dim:    #004d4a;
      --cyan-glow:   0 0 8px #00d4cc66;

      --amber:       #f5a623;
      --amber-dim:   #4a3000;
      --amber-glow:  0 0 8px #f5a62366;

      --red:         #e84040;
      --red-dim:     #4a0808;
      --red-glow:    0 0 8px #e8404077;

      --green:       #39d35f;
      --green-dim:   #1a5a2a;
      --green-glow:  0 0 8px #39d35f66;

      --text:        #b8c8d0;
      --text-mid:    #6a8898;
      --text-dim:    #384850;

      --font-mono:   'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
      --font-ui:     'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;
    }

    * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }

    body {
      background: var(--steel-bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 20px 20px 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      gap: 0;
    }

    /* ─── IDENTYFIKATOR URZĄDZENIA ─── */
    .device-header {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1480px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 4px 0 4px 2px;
      margin-bottom: -1px;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .device-id { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-mid); }
    .device-id span { color: var(--cyan); }

    /* ─── TOOLBAR ─── */
    .toolbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: stretch;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1480px;
      background: var(--steel-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-top: 2px solid var(--cyan);
      min-height: 58px;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }
    .vsep { width: 1px; background: var(--rule); align-self: stretch; flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* nawigacja */
    .nav-wrap { display: flex; align-items: stretch; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .nav-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
      color: var(--text-dim);
      padding: 0 20px;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      transition: color 0.1s, background 0.1s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .nav-btn:hover { color: var(--text-mid); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
    .nav-btn.active {
      color: var(--cyan);
      background: rgba(0,212,204,0.05);
    }
    .nav-btn.active::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -2px; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--cyan);
      box-shadow: var(--cyan-glow);
    }
    .nav-btn.active::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 7px; left: 8px;
      width: 4px; height: 4px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--cyan);
      box-shadow: var(--cyan-glow);
    }

    /* tace */
    .tray-block {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      background: var(--steel-2);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .tray-id-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; }
    .tray-num { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: var(--text-dim); }
    .tray-led { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .tray-led.cyan  { background: var(--cyan);  box-shadow: var(--cyan-glow); }
    .tray-led.amber { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: var(--amber-glow); }

    .tray-data { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
    .tray-species { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .tray-species.cyan  { color: var(--cyan); }
    .tray-species.amber { color: var(--amber); }

    .tray-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-mid); }

    .tray-progress { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
    .prog-track {
      width: 80px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--steel-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-hi);
      position: relative;
    }
    .prog-track::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top:0; left:25%; bottom:0; width:1px; background:var(--rule-hi); }
    .prog-track::after  { content: ''; position: absolute; top:0; left:50%; bottom:0; width:1px; background:var(--rule-hi); }
    .prog-fill { height: 100%; transition: width 0.5s ease; }
    .prog-fill.cyan  { background: var(--cyan); }
    .prog-fill.amber { background: var(--amber); }

    .prog-labels { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 8.5px; color: var(--text-dim); font-family: var(--font-ui); }

    .stage-tag {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      padding: 1px 5px;
      border: 1px solid;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .stage-tag.incub { border-color: var(--cyan-dim); color: var(--cyan); }
    .stage-tag.lock  { border-color: var(--amber-dim); color: var(--amber); }

    /* alarmy */
    .alarms-block {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 0 12px;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .alarm-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.8px; }
    .alarm-led {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .alarm-led.warn   { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: var(--amber-glow); border-color: #7a5000; animation: blink-slow 2s infinite; }
    .alarm-led.danger { background: var(--red);   box-shadow: var(--red-glow);   border-color: #7a0000; animation: blink-fast 0.8s infinite; }
    .alarm-led.ok     { background: #1a3a30; border-color: var(--cyan-dim); }
    .alarm-text.warn   { color: var(--amber); }
    .alarm-text.danger { color: var(--red); }
    .alarm-text.ok     { color: var(--text-dim); }

    @keyframes blink-slow { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.25} }
    @keyframes blink-fast { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.15} }

    /* prawa strona */
    .right-group { display: flex; align-items: stretch; margin-left: auto; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .sys-block {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
      background: var(--steel-2);
    }
    .sys-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
    .sys-label { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 8.5px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; }
    .sys-val { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-mid); }
    .sys-val.hot { color: var(--amber); }
    .sys-val.ok  { color: var(--cyan); }

    .mini-meter { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
    .mini-track { width: 40px; height: 3px; background: var(--steel-bg); border: 1px solid var(--rule); }
    .mini-fill { height: 100%; }
    .mini-fill.cyan { background: var(--cyan); }
    .mini-fill.blue { background: #4488cc; }
    .mini-num { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-mid); min-width: 28px; }
    .mini-key { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-dim); letter-spacing: 0.5px; width: 18px; }

    .conn-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3px 8px; }
    .conn-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-dim); }
    .conn-led { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .conn-led.on  { background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--cyan-glow); }
    .conn-led.mid { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: var(--amber-glow); }
    .conn-led.off { background: var(--rule-hi); }

    /* zegar */
    .clock-block {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: flex-end;
      padding: 0 16px;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
      gap: 3px;
    }
    .clk-time { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 3px; color: var(--text); line-height: 1; }
    .clk-date { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--text-dim); }
    .clk-pulse { display: flex; gap: 4px; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 1px; }
    .pulse-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan-dim); }
    .pulse-dot.active { background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--cyan-glow); }

    /* ─── WIDOKI ─── */
    .view { display: none; padding: 20px 0; width: 100%; max-width: 1480px; }
    .view.active { display: block; }

    /* ─── INTERNAL TABS ─── */
    .internal-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      padding-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .internal-tab-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: color 0.1s, background 0.1s;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
      position: relative;
      top: 1px;
    }
    .internal-tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text-mid); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
    .internal-tab-btn.active {
      color: var(--cyan);
      border-bottom-color: var(--cyan);
    }

    .internal-tab-content { display: none; }
    .internal-tab-content.active { display: block; }

    /* ─── GAUGES (duże wskaźniki) ─── */
    .gauges-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
      width: 100%;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      background: var(--steel-1);
      overflow-x: auto;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .gauge-cell {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 160px;
      padding: 12px 10px 10px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .gauge-cell:last-child { border-right: none; }
    .gauge-label { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; align-self: flex-start; }
    .gauge-svg { width: 100%; max-width: 150px; }
    .gauge-reading { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 1px; line-height: 1; }
    .gauge-unit { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 1px; }

    /* ─── KARTY KONFIGURACJI ─── */
    .config-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .config-card {
      background: var(--steel-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      padding: 14px 12px;
    }
    .config-card .card-title {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      padding-bottom: 6px;
    }

    /* ─── PRZEŁĄCZNIKI (wersja compact) ─── */
    .sw {
      display: inline-flex;
      background: var(--steel-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-hi);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px #00000066;
    }
    .sw-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 36px;
      height: 30px;
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #000000;
      transition: background 0.1s;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
    }
    .sw-btn:last-child { border-right: none; }
    .sw-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
    .sw-btn.is-selected {
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 4px #00000088;
    }
    .sw-btn.is-off .sym { color: #1a242c; }
    .sw-btn.is-active .sym { color: var(--cyan); text-shadow: var(--cyan-glow); }
    .sw-btn.is-forced .sym { color: var(--amber); text-shadow: var(--amber-glow); }
    .sw-btn.has-alarm .sym {
      color: var(--red);
      text-shadow: var(--red-glow);
      animation: alarm-pulse 0.8s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes alarm-pulse {
      0%,100% { opacity:1; }
      50% { opacity:0.2; }
    }

    /* ─── PWM MODUŁ ─── */
    .pwm-module {
      background: var(--steel-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-hi);
      padding: 12px 10px 10px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .pwm-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .pwm-label { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: var(--text-mid); text-transform: uppercase; }
    .pwm-slider-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .pwm-slider-track {
      flex: 1;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--steel-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 1px;
    }
    .pwm-slider-track::before,
    .pwm-slider-track::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top:0; bottom:0;
      width:1px;
      background: var(--rule-hi);
      opacity:0.5;
    }
    .pwm-slider-track::before { left:25%; }
    .pwm-slider-track::after  { left:50%; }

    .pwm-slider-fill {
      height: 100%;
      width: 0%;
      transition: width 0.15s ease;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .pwm-slider-fill.active { opacity:1; }
    .pwm-slider-fill.cyan  { background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: var(--cyan-glow); }
    .pwm-slider-fill.red   { background: var(--red);   box-shadow: var(--red-glow); }
    .pwm-slider-fill.amber { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: var(--amber-glow); }

    .pwm-thumb {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      background: var(--steel-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-hi);
      border-radius: 2px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: grab;
      transition: left 0.15s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 4px #00000088;
    }
    .pwm-thumb::after {
      content: '';
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-hi);
      border-radius: 1px;
      background: var(--steel-bg);
    }
    .pwm-thumb:active { cursor: grabbing; }

    .pwm-value {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-mid);
      min-width: 44px;
      text-align: right;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .pwm-value.active.cyan  { color: var(--cyan); }
    .pwm-value.active.red   { color: var(--red); }
    .pwm-value.forced.amber { color: var(--amber); }

    .pwm-leds {
      display: flex;
      gap: 3px;
      padding-top: 6px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    }
    .pwm-led {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      background: #0a1016;
      border: 1px solid #1a252c;
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .pwm-led.on.cyan {
      background: var(--cyan);
      border-color: var(--cyan-dim);
      box-shadow: var(--cyan-glow);
    }
    .pwm-led.on.red {
      background: var(--red);
      border-color: var(--red-dim);
      box-shadow: var(--red-glow);
    }
    .pwm-led.on.amber {
      background: var(--amber);
      border-color: var(--amber-dim);
      box-shadow: var(--amber-glow);
    }

    /* ─── DZIENNIK ─── */
    .journal-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .journal-entry {
      background: var(--steel-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .journal-entry .time { color: var(--text-dim); }
    .journal-entry .msg  { color: var(--text-mid); }

    /* ─── SYSTEM ─── */
    .sys-info {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px,1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      background: var(--steel-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      padding: 16px;
    }
    .sys-info .item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
    }
    .sys-info .item .key { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; }
    .sys-info .item .val { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); }

    /* ─── RESPONSYWNOŚĆ ─── */
    @media (max-width: 1200px) {
      .toolbar { flex-wrap: wrap; height: auto; gap: 2px; padding: 4px 0; }
      .nav-wrap { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
      .vsep { display: none; }
      .right-group { margin-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); width: 100%; justify-content: flex-end; }
      .sys-block { border-left: none; }
      .clock-block { border-left: none; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 760px) {
      .tray-block { padding: 0 8px; gap: 6px; }
      .prog-track { width: 50px; }
      .alarms-block { padding: 0 6px; }
      .sys-block { gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .clock-block { padding: 0 10px; }
      .clk-time { font-size: 17px; }
      .gauges-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .gauge-cell { min-width: 130px; }
      .config-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 500px) {
      .nav-btn { padding: 0 12px; font-size: 10px; }
      .tray-block .tray-id-col { display: none; }
      .tray-block .stage-tag { display: none; }
      .alarms-block .alarm-row .alarm-text { display: none; }
      .alarm-led { width: 6px; height: 6px; }
      .conn-grid { display: none; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════
       DEVICE HEADER
  ════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="device-header">
    <div class="device-id">INC‑2 &nbsp;// &nbsp;<span>PANEL OPERATORSKI</span></div>
    <div style="letter-spacing:1px">PROTOKÓŁ&nbsp;v2.4.1&nbsp;·&nbsp;ESP32‑S3</div>
  </div>

  <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════
       TOOLBAR (CONSOLIDATED)
  ════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="toolbar">

    <nav class="nav-wrap">
      <button class="nav-btn active" data-tab="status">STATUS</button>
      <button class="nav-btn" data-tab="config-suite">⚙ KONFIG & TESTY</button>
      <button class="nav-btn" data-tab="journal-suite">📋 DZIENNIK & HARMONOGRAM</button>
      <button class="nav-btn" data-tab="esp">📡 ESP & ZASILANIE</button>
    </nav>

    <div class="vsep"></div>

    <!-- TACA 1 -->
    <div class="tray-block">
      <div class="tray-id-col">
        <span class="tray-num">T-1</span>
        <div class="tray-led cyan"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-data">
        <span class="tray-species cyan">KURA</span>
        <div class="tray-meta">
          <span class="stage-tag incub">INKUB.</span>
          <span>12/21 dni</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-progress">
        <div class="prog-track"><div class="prog-fill cyan" style="width:57%"></div></div>
        <div class="prog-labels"><span>0</span><span>↑7d</span><span>21</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="vsep"></div>

    <!-- TACA 2 -->
    <div class="tray-block">
      <div class="tray-id-col">
        <span class="tray-num">T-2</span>
        <div class="tray-led amber" style="animation:blink-slow 1.5s infinite"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-data">
        <span class="tray-species amber">KACZKA</span>
        <div class="tray-meta">
          <span class="stage-tag lock">LOCKDOWN</span>
          <span>26/28 dni</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-progress">
        <div class="prog-track"><div class="prog-fill amber" style="width:100%"></div></div>
        <div class="prog-labels"><span>0</span><span style="color:var(--amber)">↑2d</span><span>28</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="vsep"></div>

    <!-- ALARMY -->
    <div class="alarms-block">
      <div class="alarm-row">
        <div class="alarm-led warn"></div>
        <span class="alarm-text warn">TEMP +1.2°C</span>
      </div>
      <div class="alarm-row">
        <div class="alarm-led danger"></div>
        <span class="alarm-text danger">WILG. −4%</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PRAWA STRONA -->
    <div class="right-group">

      <div class="sys-block">
        <div class="sys-col">
          <span class="sys-label">T-CHIP</span>
          <span class="sys-val hot" id="esp-temp">41.8°C</span>
        </div>
        <div class="sys-col">
          <div class="mini-meter">
            <span class="mini-key">RAM</span>
            <div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill cyan" style="width:62%"></div></div>
            <span class="mini-num" id="esp-ram">62%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="mini-meter">
            <span class="mini-key">FL</span>
            <div class="mini-track"><div class="mini-fill blue" style="width:18%"></div></div>
            <span class="mini-num" id="esp-fl">18%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="sys-col">
          <span class="sys-label">STATUS</span>
          <div class="conn-grid">
            <div class="conn-item"><div class="conn-led on"></div>WiFi</div>
            <div class="conn-item"><div class="conn-led on"></div>MQTT</div>
            <div class="conn-item"><div class="conn-led mid"></div>NTP</div>
            <div class="conn-item"><div class="conn-led off"></div>BLE</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="clock-block">
        <div class="clk-time" id="clk-hms">--:--:--</div>
        <div class="clk-date" id="clk-date">--.--.----</div>
        <div class="clk-pulse">
          <div class="pulse-dot" id="p0"></div>
          <div class="pulse-dot" id="p1"></div>
          <div class="pulse-dot" id="p2"></div>
          <div class="pulse-dot" id="p3"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════
       WIDOKI (CONSOLIDATED)
  ════════════════════════════════════════ -->

  <!-- ─── STATUS ─── -->
  <div id="view-status" class="view active">
    <div class="gauges-row">

      <div class="gauge-cell">
        <span class="gauge-label">TEMP. INKUB.</span>
        <svg class="gauge-svg" viewBox="0 0 160 100">
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#1a2228" stroke-width="10"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#003322" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="120 189" stroke-dashoffset="-35"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="94 189" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          <g fill="none" stroke="#2a3840" stroke-width="1">
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-90,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="24" y2="90" transform="rotate(-67.5,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="24" y2="90" transform="rotate(-22.5,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(0,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="24" y2="90" transform="rotate(22.5,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="24" y2="90" transform="rotate(67.5,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(90,80,90)"/>
          </g>
          <text x="16" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">35</text>
          <text x="144" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">42</text>
          <text x="80" y="36" fill="#2a8060" font-size="7" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">▌NORMA▐</text>
          <line x1="80" y1="90" x2="80" y2="36" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(25,80,90)"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="4" fill="var(--steel-2)" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="var(--cyan)"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="gauge-reading" style="color:var(--cyan)">37.8</div>
        <div class="gauge-unit">°C &nbsp;[35–42]</div>
      </div>

      <div class="gauge-cell">
        <span class="gauge-label">WILGOTNOŚĆ</span>
        <svg class="gauge-svg" viewBox="0 0 160 100">
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#1a2228" stroke-width="10"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#002233" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="94 189" stroke-dashoffset="-47"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="75 189" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          <g fill="none" stroke="#2a3840" stroke-width="1">
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-90,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(0,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(90,80,90)"/>
          </g>
          <text x="16" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">30</text>
          <text x="144" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">80</text>
          <line x1="80" y1="90" x2="80" y2="36" stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-width="1.5" transform="rotate(-10,80,90)"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="4" fill="var(--steel-2)" stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
          <circle cx="80" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="var(--amber)"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="gauge-reading" style="color:var(--amber)">48</div>
        <div class="gauge-unit">%RH &nbsp;[45–75]</div>
      </div>

      <div class="gauge-cell">
        <span class="gauge-label">TEMP. ZEWN.</span>
        <svg class="gauge-svg" viewBox="0 0 160 100">
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#1a2228" stroke-width="10"/>
          <path d="M20 90 A60 60 0 0 1 140 90" fill="none" stroke="#4488cc" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="82 189" stroke-linecap="square"/>
          <g fill="none" stroke="#2a3840" stroke-width="1">
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-90,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(-45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(0,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(45,80,90)"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="26" y2="90" transform="rotate(90,80,90)"/>
          </g>
          <text x="16" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">-5</text>
          <text x="144" y="88" fill="#384850" font-size="8" font-family="'Share Tech Mono',monospace" text-anchor="middle">40</text>

    <div style="margin-top:12px;background:var(--steel-2);border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:16px;font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);text-align:center">

    </div>

  <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════
       SKRYPTY
  ════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <script>
    (function() {
      'use strict';

      // ─── ZEGAR ──────────────────────────────
      function updateClock() {
        const now = new Date();
        document.getElementById('clk-hms').textContent =
          now.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL', { hour12: false });
        document.getElementById('clk-date').textContent =
          now.toLocaleDateString('pl-PL', { day:'2-digit', month:'2-digit', year:'numeric' });

        const s = now.getSeconds() % 4;
        for (let i=0; i<4; i++) {
          const d = document.getElementById('p'+i);
          if (d) d.classList.toggle('active', i === s);
        }
      }
      updateClock();
      setInterval(updateClock, 1000);

      // ─── NAWIGACJA (MAIN TABS) ──────────────────────────
      const navBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn');
      const views = {
        status: document.getElementById('view-status'),
        'config-suite': document.getElementById('view-config-suite'),
        'journal-suite': document.getElementById('view-journal-suite'),
        esp: document.getElementById('view-esp')
      };

      navBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          navBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
          this.classList.add('active');

          const tab = this.dataset.tab;
          Object.keys(views).forEach(key => {
            views[key].classList.toggle('active', key === tab);
          });
        });
      });

      // ─── INTERNAL TAB SWITCHING ──────────────────────────
      window.switchConfigSuiteTab = function(subtab) {
        // Hide all internal views
        document.getElementById('config-view').classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('kalibracja-view').classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('logi-view').classList.remove('active');
        
        // Deselect all buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('#view-config-suite .internal-tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        
        // Show selected and mark button as active
        if(subtab === 'config') {
          document.getElementById('config-view').classList.add('active');
          document.querySelector('[data-subtab="config"]').classList.add('active');
        } else if(subtab === 'kalibracja') {
          document.getElementById('kalibracja-view').classList.add('active');
          document.querySelector('[data-subtab="kalibracja"]').classList.add('active');
        } else if(subtab === 'logi') {
          document.getElementById('logi-view').classList.add('active');
          document.querySelector('[data-subtab="logi"]').classList.add('active');
        }
      };

      window.switchJournalSuiteTab = function(subtab) {
        // Hide all internal views
        document.getElementById('journal-view').classList.remove('active');
        document.getElementById('harmonogram-view').classList.remove('active');
        
        // Deselect all buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('#view-journal-suite .internal-tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        
        // Show selected and mark button as active
        if(subtab === 'journal') {
          document.getElementById('journal-view').classList.add('active');
          document.querySelector('[data-subtab="journal"]').classList.add('active');
        } else if(subtab === 'harmonogram') {
          document.getElementById('harmonogram-view').classList.add('active');
          document.querySelector('[data-subtab="harmonogram"]').classList.add('active');
        }
      };

      // ─── PRZEŁĄCZNIKI (SW) ──────────────────
      document.querySelectorAll('.sw').forEach(sw => {
        const btns = sw.querySelectorAll('.sw-btn');
        btns.forEach(btn => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const val = this.dataset.val;
            btns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('is-selected', 'is-off', 'is-active', 'is-forced', 'has-alarm'));
            this.classList.add('is-selected');
            if (val === 'off') this.classList.add('is-off');

            const ch = sw.dataset.ch;
            sw.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sw-change', {
              bubbles: true,
              detail: { ch, val }
            }));
          });
        });
      });

      // ─── PWM ─────────────────────────────────
      document.querySelectorAll('.pwm-module').forEach(module => {
        const track = module.querySelector('.pwm-slider-track');
        const fill = track.querySelector('.pwm-slider-fill');
        const thumb = track.querySelector('.pwm-thumb');
        const valSpan = module.querySelector('[data-pwm-val]');
        const leds = module.querySelectorAll('[data-pwm-leds] .pwm-led');
        const type = module.dataset.type || 'heater';
        const ch = module.dataset.ch;

        let value = 0;
        let active = false;
        let forced = false;

        function render() {
          const pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (value / 255) * 100));
          thumb.style.left = pct + '%';
          fill.style.width = pct + '%';
          valSpan.textContent = value;

          const on = active;
          const forcedClass = forced ? 'amber' : (type === 'heater' ? 'red' : 'cyan');
          const offClass = type === 'heater' ? 'red' : 'cyan';

          fill.className = 'pwm-slider-fill ' + (on ? (forced ? 'amber' : offClass) : '') + (on ? ' active' : '');
          valSpan.className = 'pwm-value' + (on ? ' active ' + (forced ? 'amber' : offClass) : '');

          const ledCount = Math.round((value / 255) * leds.length);
          leds.forEach((led, i) => {
            led.className = 'pwm-led';
            if (on && i < ledCount) {
              led.classList.add('on', forced ? 'amber' : offClass);
            }
          });
        }

        // Obsługa suwaka
        let dragging = false;

        function handleMove(e) {
          const rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
          let x = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
          x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
          value = Math.round(x * 255);
          render();
          track.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pwm-change', {
            bubbles: true,
            detail: { ch, value }
          }));
        }

        track.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
          dragging = true;
          handleMove(e);
          document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
          document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
        });

        function onMouseMove(e) { if (dragging) handleMove(e); }
        function onMouseUp() {
          dragging = false;
          document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
          document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
        }

        track.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { handleMove(e.touches[0]); e.preventDefault(); });
        track.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { handleMove(e.touches[0]); e.preventDefault(); });

        module.pwmApi = {
          setValue: (v) => { value = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, Math.round(v))); render(); },
          setActive: (a) => { active = a; render(); },
          setForced: (f) => { forced = f; render(); },
          getValue: () => value,
          getState: () => ({ value, active, forced })
        };

        render();
      });

      // ─── DEMO VALUES ────────────────────────
      setTimeout(() => {
        const grz0 = document.querySelector('[data-ch="grz0-pwm"]')?.pwmApi;
        const grz1 = document.querySelector('[data-ch="grz1-pwm"]')?.pwmApi;
        const tray1 = document.querySelector('[data-ch="tray1-pwm"]')?.pwmApi;
        const tray2 = document.querySelector('[data-ch="tray2-pwm"]')?.pwmApi;

        if (grz0) { grz0.setValue(180); grz0.setActive(true); }
        if (grz1) { grz1.setValue(80); grz1.setActive(false); }
        if (tray1) { tray1.setValue(140); tray1.setActive(true); }
        if (tray2) { tray2.setValue(0); tray2.setActive(false); }

        document.getElementById('grz0-status').textContent = 'AUTO · pracuje';
        document.getElementById('grz1-status').textContent = 'AUTO · bezczynna';
        document.getElementById('tray1-status').textContent = 'AUTO · obrót aktywny';
        document.getElementById('tray2-status').textContent = 'ALARM · lockdown';
      }, 200);

    })();
  </script>

</body>
</html>

```

```
function initSwitch3Handlers(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.switch-3 .track').forEach(track=>{
    const switchEl=track.closest('.switch-3');
    if(!switchEl) return;
    const idStr=switchEl.id||'';
    let type='',idx=0;
    if(idStr.startsWith('heater-switch-')){
      type='heater';
      idx=parseInt(idStr.slice('heater-switch-'.length));
    } else if(idStr.startsWith('diff-switch-')){
      type='diffuser';
      idx=parseInt(idStr.slice('diff-switch-'.length));
    }
    if(!type || isNaN(idx)) return;
    track.addEventListener('click',(e)=>{
      const rect=track.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x=e.clientX-rect.left;
      const width=rect.width;
      let mode='auto';
      if(x<width/3) mode='off';
      else if(x>2*width/3) mode='on';
      if(type==='heater'){
        if(mode==='off') toggleHeaterPower(idx, false);
        else if(mode==='auto') setHeaterAuto(idx);
        else setHeaterManual(idx);
      } else if(type==='diffuser'){
        if(mode==='off') toggleDiffuserPower(idx, false);
        else if(mode==='auto') toggleDiffuserPower(idx, true);
        else toggleDiffuserPower(idx, true);
      }
    });
  });
}
function initTrayModeSliders(){
  [0,1].forEach((trayIndex)=>{
    const root = document.getElementById('status-tray'+trayIndex+'-mode');
    if(!root) return;
    const track = root.querySelector('.toggle-track');
    if(!track) return;
    track.addEventListener('click',(e)=>{
      const rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const width = rect.width;
      let mode = 'auto';
      if(x < width / 3) mode = 'off';
      else if(x > 2 * width / 3) mode = 'on';
      setTrayMode(trayIndex, mode);
    });
    updateTrayModeUI(trayIndex);
  });
}
```

    const switchEl=track.closest('.switch-3');
    if(!switchEl) return;
    const idStr=switchEl.id||'';
    let type='',idx=0;
    if(idStr.startsWith('heater-switch-')){
      type='heater';
      idx=parseInt(idStr.slice('heater-switch-'.length));
    } else if(idStr.startsWith('diff-switch-')){
      type='diffuser';
      idx=parseInt(idStr.slice('diff-switch-'.length));
    }
    if(!type || isNaN(idx)) return;
    track.addEventListener('click',(e)=>{
      const rect=track.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x=e.clientX-rect.left;
      const width=rect.width;
      let mode='auto';
      if(x<width/3) mode='off';
      else if(x>2*width/3) mode='on';
      
      // Update UI immediately
      updateSwitch3UI(switchEl, mode);
      
      // Then send command
      if(type==='heater'){
        if(mode==='off') toggleHeaterPower(idx, false);
        else if(mode==='auto') setHeaterAuto(idx);
        else setHeaterManual(idx);
      } else if(type==='diffuser'){
        if(mode==='off') toggleDiffuserPower(idx, false);
        else if(mode==='auto') toggleDiffuserPower(idx, true);
        else toggleDiffuserPower(idx, true);
      }
    });
  });
}
function updateSwitch3UI(switchEl, mode){
  const slider=switchEl.querySelector('.slider');
  const syms=switchEl.querySelectorAll('.sym');
  if(!slider) return;
  
  // Remove all position classes
  slider.classList.remove('pos-0','pos-1','pos-2');
  
  // Set new position based on mode
  const modeToPos={'off':0,'auto':1,'on':2};
  const pos=modeToPos[mode]??1;
  const posClasses=['pos-0','pos-1','pos-2'];
  slider.classList.add(posClasses[pos]);
  
  // Update symbol active state
  syms.forEach(sym=>{
    sym.classList.remove('active');
    if(sym.dataset.mode===mode) sym.classList.add('active');
  });
}
```

function initSwitch3Handlers(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.switch-3 .track').forEach(track=>{
    const switchEl=track.closest('.switch-3');
    if(!switchEl) return;
    const idStr=switchEl.id||'';
    let type='',idx=0;
    if(idStr.startsWith('heater-switch-')){
      type='heater';
      idx=parseInt(idStr.slice('heater-switch-'.length));
    } else if(idStr.startsWith('diff-switch-')){
      type='diffuser';
      idx=parseInt(idStr.slice('diff-switch-'.length));
    } else if(idStr.startsWith('tray-switch-')){
      type='tray';
      idx=parseInt(idStr.slice('tray-switch-'.length));
    }
    if(!type || isNaN(idx)) return;
    track.addEventListener('click',(e)=>{
      const rect=track.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x=e.clientX-rect.left;
      const width=rect.width;
      let mode='auto';
      if(x<width/3) mode='off';
      else if(x>2*width/3) mode='on';
      
      // Update UI immediately
      updateSwitch3UI(switchEl, mode);
      
      // Then send command
      if(type==='heater'){
        if(mode==='off') toggleHeaterPower(idx, false);
        else if(mode==='auto') setHeaterAuto(idx);
        else setHeaterManual(idx);
      } else if(type==='diffuser'){
        if(mode==='off') toggleDiffuserPower(idx, false);
        else if(mode==='auto') toggleDiffuserPower(idx, true);
        else toggleDiffuserPower(idx, true);
      } else if(type==='tray'){
        if(mode==='off') setTrayMode(idx, 'off');
        else if(mode==='auto') setTrayMode(idx, 'auto');
        else setTrayMode(idx, 'on');
      }
    });
  });
}
```
